purpose: Teach: 見知らぬ/さんざん/もどる/気まま/だんだんと/何気なく/アナタ/ありとあらゆる

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、見知らぬ人にはついていかないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't go off with strangers, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but clear instruction. Calm, matter-of-fact delivery. A mother's care wrapped in practicality, not alarm. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、昨日のテスト、さんざんだったよ
lines.en: Mom, yesterday's test was a total disaster.
lines.style: Quiet, rueful confession. A small sigh underneath. Not asking for sympathy — just stating the fact to the person he trusts. Slightly downward gaze.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お部屋にもどるまで気をつけてね
lines.en: Sho, be careful until you get back to your room, okay?
lines.style: Warm check-in. Specific concern without hovering. The kind of gentle reminder that says 'I'm thinking of you.' Soft, attentive tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お休みは気ままに過ごしたいな
lines.en: Mom, I want to spend my days off however I feel like.
lines.style: Wistful, half-daydreaming. A quiet bid for freedom that isn't quite a complaint. Hopeful underneath, testing whether this wish is allowed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、だんだんと寒くなってきたわね
lines.en: Sho, it's getting colder and colder, isn't it?
lines.style: Observational, almost to herself. A quiet noticing of the season's shift. Warmth in the voice — the kind of small comment that invites closeness without demanding it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、何気なく窓を開けたら、お祖父ちゃんがいたよ
lines.en: Mom, when I opened the window just now, Grandpa was there!
lines.style: Bright, surprised burst of discovery. Quick opening. Genuine delight that something unexpected happened. Alive in the moment. Small pitch lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、アナタが嫌がる事は絶対しないよ
lines.en: Sho, I would never make you do something you hate.
lines.style: Quiet, steady reassurance. No performance — just a promise. Tender but not uncertain. The steady voice of someone who means exactly what she says.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ありとあらゆる遊びを試したいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to try every kind of game there is.
lines.style: Eager but thoughtful. Not demanding — genuinely curious, reaching. A boy who's considering possibilities. Warmth in his hope. Close and trusting tone.
